title: Add gf2-sim to README workspace table and fix GPU LDPC BP attribution
description:
**Severity: high · Dimension: doc-drift** (report finding #5)

`README.md` omits `gf2-sim` entirely from the workspace layout table, despite it being a full workspace member with its own `Pipeline`/`Stage`/`Connector` infrastructure. Additionally the table attributes GPU LDPC BP to `gf2-coding --features hip`, but no GPU LDPC BP code exists in `gf2-coding` — it lives in `gf2-sim/src/gpu/ldpc_bp.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `README.md` workspace table gains a `gf2-sim` row describing the CPU+GPU FEC simulation pipeline crate and its `hip` / `llr-f64` features.
- [hard] The "LDPC BP" GPU attribution is removed from the `gf2-coding` hip-feature description and correctly placed on `gf2-sim`.
- [hard] Claims verified against actual code paths before committing (no new drift introduced).
